mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES stays depressed while TRANSIT remains weak, weekday trip chains into shopping districts stay thin and RETAIL_REC stays below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-weeks mean even though WORKPLACES remains below -15 and TRANSIT remains below -25 for the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A higher RESIDENTIAL share signals more time spent locally, so near-home shopping and leisure substitute for destination retail and keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 19 and holds for 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is elevated around 19 percent in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the previous two-week average after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 19 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after a prior trough pulls discretionary outdoor trips and family outings away from enclosed retail, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns up by at least 8 points from its recent low
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite PARKS recovering by 8 or more points from its recent low.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve from their current depressed levels, commuting and office-linked errands resume and RETAIL_REC rises within one week and stays higher for four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to move above its last-week level in the week after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise, or it remains lower over the following four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently weak GROCERY_PHARM combined with weak RETAIL_REC indicates fewer combined errand trips, and that slack persists into the next month, keeping retail-and-recreation mobility below the recent baseline.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last-28-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays near zero or negative.

mechanism_narrative: A larger gap between RESIDENTIAL and TRANSIT implies stay-at-home behavior and fewer discretionary outings, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next two weeks as that gap widens.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is around 19 while TRANSIT is around -33 in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken within two weeks after the RESIDENTIAL minus TRANSIT gap remains above 45.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, flat or falling WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility suppress nonessential visits and push RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises for two consecutive weeks or posts a higher 28-day mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain subdued.
